user.title: Garden Planner
user.description: Choose where tasks go and a starting point for your frost dates. You can adjust the dates on the next page.

data_description.zone: Hardiness zones only roughly predict frost dates, so check them against local averages on the next page.

location.title: Frost dates and greenhouse
location.description: Crop timings are stored as days before or after your frost dates.

data_description.lookahead_days: Tasks further out stay in the planner until they come into view, so long succession sowings don't flood the list.
data_description.last_frost: Average date of the last frost in spring.
data_description.first_frost: Average date of the first frost in fall.
data_description.warm_last_frost: Tomatoes, peppers, squash and other frost-tender crops are timed from this date instead. Set it later than your last frost where spring stays cool, like coastal BC. Leave empty to use the last frost.
data_description.offset_days: Negative for earlier, positive for later. Use this to fine-tune for a warm or cold garden.

add_planting.name: Add planting
add_planting.description: Plan a crop and add its tasks.

crop.name: Crop
crop.description: Crop from the catalog, or the key of a crop you added.

year.name: Year
year.description: Growing year. Defaults to this year, or next year from September on.

season.name: Season
season.description: Which window to use when a crop has more than one, such as spring, summer or fall. Defaults to the first.

start_date.name: Start date
start_date.description: Transplant date for indoor starts, or first sowing date for direct sowing. Defaults to the start of the crop's window.

succession_days.name: Repeat every
succession_days.description: Sow again every this many days. 0 means a single sowing.

succession_until.name: Repeat until
succession_until.description: Last date for a repeat sowing. Defaults to the end of the crop's window.

variety.name: Variety
variety.description: Shown in task names, for example Sungold.

preview_planting.name: Preview planting
preview_planting.description: Show the tasks a planting would create, without saving it.

remove_planting.name: Remove planting
remove_planting.description: Remove a planting and its open tasks.

planting_id.name: Planting ID
planting_id.description: From the Plantings sensor or the add planting response.

add_crop.name: Add crop
add_crop.description: Add a crop or variety, or override a built-in one.

key.name: Key
key.description: Lowercase id, for example tomato_sungold. Using a built-in key overrides that crop.

based_on.name: Based on
based_on.description: Copy windows and defaults from this crop, then apply the other fields.

windows.name: Windows
windows.description: List of windows with a season and ranges for indoor, direct, transplant and cover. Each range is two dates, either MM-DD for your garden or offsets like L-14 (14 days before last frost) and F+7 (7 days after first frost).

days_to_harvest.name: Days to harvest
days_to_harvest.description: From sowing, or planting for garlic and potatoes.

pot_up.name: Pot up
pot_up.description: Add a pot-up task for indoor starts.

sync.name: Sync
sync.description: Sync tasks with the task list now.
